'''Dace Ran''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] merchant living in the town of [[Raider's Cove]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dace Ran appears as a modification vendor in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
